label: Diagram 5.1
caption: Diagram 5.1 Type C, plan view showing minimum dimensions
description: This is a plan view captioned "Diagram 5.1 Type C, plan view showing minimum dimensions". A legend on the right defines a green shaded square as "Activity space WC". The plan depicts a toilet (WC) drawn as an oval with a dashed mid-line on the left, adjacent to a green rectangular activity space, over which a dashed circle is marked "465mm Ø". Along the top wall, left to right, the labels read "Shelf", "Space for disposal bin", "Horizontal grab rail", "Vertical grab rail", "High hook and low hook", and "Activity zone", dimensioned "1465mm minimum", "540mm" and "100mm". The left edge carries "920mm minimum" and "200mm". Interior dimensions include "400mm", "200mm" and "565mm". A hinged "Horizontal closing bar" at the right is dimensioned "500mm", "750mm" and "60mm". The bottom edge shows "60mm", "600mm", "100mm" with labels "Horizontal grab rail", "Vertical grab rail" and "Column of clearance". A NOTES block with three numbered points sits at the right.
